title: License vehicles that carry dangerous goods in bulk
what: Use a road vehicle to carry dangerous goods in a receptacle over 500 L, or over 500 kg in a receptacle, only if the vehicle is licensed for those goods (drivers also need a dangerous goods driver licence).

laws.title: Dangerous Goods (Road and Rail Transport) Regulation 2022 (NSW)

sources.title: Dangerous Goods (Road and Rail Transport) Regulation 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A road vehicle must not be used to transport either of the following unless the vehicle is licensed under this Part to transport the goods— (a) dangerous goods in a receptacle with a capacity of more than 500L, (b) more than 500kg of dangerous goods in a receptacle
